QUOTE: The text before the first `:` is matched against the tool name with `fnmatch`. Example: `filesystem.*` matches all filesystem tools. - With no `:`, a match on the tool name is enough.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the pattern splits at the first colon, the tool part is matched with fnmatch, and a pattern with no colon matches on the tool name alone.
